# Results — Study 805 (Cokurtosis Premium)

*Generated by [`examples/verify.py`](../examples/verify.py). The claim under test — Fang &
Lai (1997), four-moment CAPM: a name's **systematic kurtosis** (its **cokurtosis** with the
market) is a priced risk, so high-cokurtosis names earn a **positive** premium and a long-
high-cokurt / short-low-cokurt book should earn a positive spread. Offline & deterministic
once cached; run `python examples/verify.py` to reproduce every number. As-of **2026-06-30**
(the sample is pinned as-of 2026-06-30, the last complete calendar month; the partial
current month is dropped). Fingerprint
`357fd262912f` (panel Close).*

## Data stamp

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Real tape | yfinance daily OHLC (`auto_adjust=True`, total-return), **50 liquid US large-caps**, 2010-01-04 → 2026-06-30, **4,147** dated rows/name |
| Universe | a fixed `UNIVERSE` of ~50 mega-caps, pulled through the **`quantlab.universe` survivorship guard** (`download_panel(..., allow_survivorship_bias=True)`), cached under this study's own `_cache/` |
| Market | the **equal-weight cross-sectional mean** of the panel's daily simple returns |
| Signal | each name's **trailing-252-day cokurtosis with the market**, `E[(r_i−μ_i)(r_m−μ_m)^3]/(σ_i·σ_m^3)` (a standardised fourth co-moment, vectorised via rolling raw moments), known at the close of `t−1` (one `shift`) |
| Sort | each day rank the cross-section by the signal; **long the top 30%** (high cokurtosis), **short the bottom 30%** (low cokurtosis), equal-weight; measure the day-`t` forward return of each book |
| Execution / costs | one documented lag: signal through close `t−1` → hold day `t`. The costed timer charges 2 sides × one-way cost × NAV per day on the long-short book; the short book pays 50 bps/yr borrow |
| Statistics | Newey-West (HAC, 10-lag) *t* on the daily spread; one-sample *t*; Welch *t* on the pooled high-vs-low books; a 1,000-permutation placebo; a 20-seed synthetic positive control |

**Survivorship — named on the Signal axis.** `UNIVERSE` is a **current-membership** list of
names that are liquid mega-caps *today*, so the magnitudes are an **upper bound**. Higher
co-moments are documented as fragile out of sample; a 50-mega-cap survivor panel is a place
where a genuine cokurtosis premium, if it exists, should show up only faintly.

## The headline — long-high-cokurt / short-low-cokurt spread

Daily equal-weight top-30% minus bottom-30% cokurtosis spread (n = **3,894** days, median
**50** names/day):

| quantity | value |
|---|--:|
| **spread (long high-cokurt − short low-cokurt)** | **−0.15 bps/day** |
| Newey-West(10) *t* | **−0.11** |
| one-sample *t* | −0.11 |
| high-cokurt book / low-cokurt book | +7.39 bps / +7.54 bps (Welch *t* = −0.06) |
| gross spread Sharpe (no cost) | −0.03 |

The claimed edge **does not appear at all.** Fang-Lai predict a *positive* long-high /
short-low spread (high-cokurtosis names earn a premium); on this mega-cap universe the
spread is **−0.15 bps/day** with a Newey-West *t* of **−0.11** — statistically and
economically **indistinguishable from zero**, and if anything a hair on the wrong side. The
two books earn essentially the same +7.4 bps/day (a Welch *t* of −0.06 between them). There
is no systematic-kurtosis premium to harvest here.

## Placebo — is there any relation at all in the sort?

Keep the trailing-cokurtosis sort but read each day's forward returns from a
**column-permuted** panel (signal → outcome link broken), 1,000 permutations (20 seeds × 50):

| quantity | value |
|---|--:|
| observed spread | **−0.15 bps** |
| placebo mean (sd) | +0.010 bps (1.131) |
| position of observed | **−0.14 sd** from the null (right-tail p = 0.541) |

The observed spread sits right in the **middle** of the permutation null — exactly where a
non-signal lands. Nothing to explain.

## Robustness — two eras (split 2018-01-01)

| era | spread | NW *t* |
|---|--:|--:|
| 2010-01 → 2018-01 (n=1,760) | −1.95 bps | −1.21 |
| 2018-01 → 2026-06 (n=2,134) | +1.33 bps | +0.61 |

The (already null) spread even **flips sign** between halves and is insignificant in both —
the hallmark of noise, not a stable premium.

## The timer — can you get paid for it?

Charge 2 sides × one-way × NAV per day on the long-short book; short pays 50 bps/yr borrow.

| one-way cost | gross/day | cost/day | net/day | *t* (net) | Sharpe (net) | ~ann. |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| **1 bp** | −0.15 bps | 2.14 bps | **−2.29 bps** | −1.61 | −0.41 | −5.8%/yr |
| **5 bps** | −0.15 bps | 10.14 bps | **−10.29 bps** | −7.26 | −1.85 | −25.9%/yr |

There is no gross edge to defend; costs simply turn a zero into a loss. **Mirage.**

## Synthetic positive control — the machinery is unbiased

Deterministic seeded panel with a common market shock and a persistent per-name
tail-co-movement tilt that makes the name load on the *cubed* market shock (raising its
cokurtosis) and — with `knob>0` — raises its forward mean (the priced premium). No network.

| world | spread NW *t* |
|---|--:|
| null (`knob = 0`), **20 seeds** | mean **+0.03** (sd 0.90), **\|t\| ≥ 2 in 0/20 seeds** |
| planted (`knob = 0.009`, seed 805) | **+7.20** (Welch *t* = +9.19) |

The detector recovers a *planted* cokurtosis premium cleanly and never fires on the null — so
the flat real-tape result is a genuine **absence** of the effect on the mega-cap universe, not
a broken sort. *(A faithful-engine / power check only — never cited in support of the
real-tape stamp.)*

## Verdict

- **Signal — NONE.** The Fang-Lai systematic-kurtosis premium does **not** replicate on 50
  liquid US mega-caps. The specified long-high-cokurt / short-low-cokurt spread is
  **−0.15 bps/day** (NW *t* = **−0.11**) — a flat zero, sitting −0.14 sd from a
  1,000-permutation placebo null, flipping sign between eras (*t* = −1.21 / +0.61), with a
  clean 20-seed synthetic control that recovers a planted premium at *t* = +7.20. The claimed
  edge is simply absent on this universe.
- **Tradability — MIRAGE.** There is no gross edge to monetise; the costed book loses money
  (−2.29 bps/day at 1 bp one-way, −10.29 at 5 bps). A paycheck from thin air is a Mirage.
